title: Simple textures.
description: This texture pack makes every block in the game very simple and max 4 colors.
body:
I have not been making texture packs for long. I hope that this texture pack will be easy on slow computers. I dont know _if_ it will do that, but i dont care if this will get any attention, so please download this pack and at least try it. Thank you.

_Edit :_ I will finish it this time
